text.tspan: Receipt issuance and failure custody
A timeout or response value does not dispose of roots
Preparing / source owns headers and root discovery
R + target reservations + stable identities
No receipt has been issued
RTF01--02 / confirmed precommit abort
Source keeps storage / roots / VM dependencies
Only private target resources may roll back
Protected RootTransferPermit
G serializes cancel versus commit claim
Committing wins: await actual mutation disposition
MembershipCommitted / target owns storage
Handoff owns prepared roots and held VM boundary
Stable completion publication before G consumption
RTF03--04 / unpublished or unknown mutation
No success receipt; do not free or resume
Resolve known facts OR retain real quarantine
No source-destructor rollback after commit
RootTransferReceipt issued by runtime coordinator
Matching identity + permit + membership commit
Target discovery publication + live dependency custody
RTF05 / reply lost or task delivery fails
Resolve SAME TransferId / AttemptId
Target roots stay registered; existing work stays counted
Scoped current use requires live leases
Receipt is not VM / heap release authority
Receipt is not old scan-facility retirement authority
